{{Top|leg}}
'''Receiver dish stations''' were an external piece of technology installed aboard [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class Droid Control Ships]] that allowed droid starfighters to be launched.<ref name="Starfighter">[[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']]</ref> In 32 BBY,<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' says that the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] occurred in 32 BBY.</ref> [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Flight]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Rhys Dallows]] destroyed the receiver dish stations on the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Vuutun Palaa/Legends|droid control ship]] that controlled the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] that was occupying the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="Starfighter" />
